::: {#exr-palindrome-trace}
#### Is it a palindrome?

The algorithm `pal`, in the pseudocode of @rem-pseudocode,
tests whether a string is a palindrome (@def-palindrome):

```text
procedure pal(s)        // s is a string s[1] s[2] ... s[n] of n symbols
    if n <= 1
        return true
    if s[1] != s[n]
        return false
    return pal(s[2..n-1])   // s without its first and last symbols
```

Here `!=` means $\ne$,
and `s[2..n-1]` is the string of the symbols `s[2]` through `s[n-1]`,
which is the empty string when $n = 2$, since the range `2..1` is empty.
Run `pal(level)` by hand:
write down each call of `pal` that it makes, and what each call returns.

:::
